TABLE.NAME: enrol_apply_applicationinfo
TABLE.COMMENT: Additional information submitted with each enrolment application.

FIELD.NAME: userenrolmentid
FIELD.COMMENT: user enrolment id this entry belongs to

FIELD.NAME: comment
FIELD.COMMENT: comment given by the user during application

TABLE.NAME: enrol_apply_submission
TABLE.COMMENT: Durable record of one enrolment application: what was submitted, what was decided, by whom and when. Outlives the user enrolment, the enrol instance and the course it names, which is why only the two user columns carry a foreign key.

FIELD.NAME: courseid
FIELD.COMMENT: course applied for; half of the natural key, and kept when the course is deleted

FIELD.NAME: userid
FIELD.COMMENT: applicant; zeroed when the course is deleted

FIELD.NAME: enrolid
FIELD.COMMENT: enrol instance applied to, for the backup and the approval queue

FIELD.NAME: userenrolmentid
FIELD.COMMENT: reference only, never a key: the row it points at is deleted on cancellation

FIELD.NAME: userinfodata
FIELD.COMMENT: frozen JSON snapshot of the profile values submitted

FIELD.NAME: outcomemessage
FIELD.COMMENT: message the decider wrote to the applicant

FIELD.NAME: timecreated
FIELD.COMMENT: when the application was submitted; the retention sweep reads this

FIELD.NAME: timedecided
FIELD.COMMENT: when it was decided, 0 while undecided

FIELD.NAME: decidedby
FIELD.COMMENT: who decided it; zeroed when the course is deleted

KEY.NAME: user
KEY.COMMENT: the applicant, and what makes core's privacy table coverage test see this table

KEY.NAME: decidedby
KEY.COMMENT: the second personal-data role; that test reads single-field foreign keys to user.id and the literal column name userid, and nothing else

INDEX.NAME: courseuser
INDEX.COMMENT: the natural lookup key; deliberately NOT unique, see db/upgrade.php

INDEX.NAME: enrolid
INDEX.COMMENT: an index and not a foreign key: the row outlives the enrol instance on purpose

INDEX.NAME: userenrolmentid
INDEX.COMMENT: an index and not a foreign key: the row outlives the user enrolment on purpose

INDEX.NAME: timecreated
INDEX.COMMENT: the retention sweep orders and filters on this

TABLE.NAME: enrol_apply_groups
TABLE.COMMENT: Groups an applicant is added to once their enrolment application is approved.

FIELD.NAME: enrolid
FIELD.COMMENT: enrol instance the mapping belongs to
